packet.headline_seed: Trump and officials 'likely' targets of press dinner shooting suspect, authorities believe
packet.description_seed: The suspect is expected to be charged with assault of a federal officer and using a firearm during a crime of violence, officials have said.

what: Trump and officials 'likely' targets of press dinner shooting suspect, authorities believe

clean_source_blocks.text: The suspect is expected to be charged with assault of a federal officer and using a firearm during a crime of violence, officials have said.

US President Donald Trump and his officials were the "likely" targets of a suspected gunman who attempted to storm the White House Correspondents' Dinner, acting US Attorney General Todd Blanche has said.
The suspect in the White House Correspondents' Dinner shooting, has been identified as a California teacher Cole Thomas Allen, 31, from Torrance, California.

He has told NBC's Meet the Press that investigators are looking at reports the alleged gunman assembled the weapon at the Washington Hilton hotel where the dinner was held, adding that the suspect "didn't get very far".
